# Appendix — Battery R4: the review's controls (auto-generated by scripts/analysis_r4.py)

Pre-registered in PLANO (2026-09-01) before any cell; analysis written before the data. One backend for every cell (torch bf16, Qwen3-8B-Base, layer 18, 1500 tokens, RNG 0, habituated carrier); judge protocol P1 (generated-only 96-token windows, k = 5, median). Unit = premise.

## R4b — pulseG20 versus text interruption on 30 premises (TOST)

Premises complete: 30 of 30 (pools: confirmatory 10, original 10, expository 10).

| contrast | Δ surprise [CI95] | p two-sided | IC90 | TOST ±0.75 (pre-registered) | TOST ±0.5 (reported) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| pulseG20 − inter | -0.287 [-0.733, +0.171] | 0.2278 | [-0.682, +0.108] | p = 0.0280 → **EQUIVALENT** | p = 0.1839 → not shown |

Paired SD 1.273; power to declare ±0.75-equivalence at a true difference of 0 with this SD and n = 30: 0.87 (±0.5: 0.35).
- connection: Δ -0.519 [-0.959, -0.087], p = 0.0298
- coherence: Δ -0.896 [-1.202, -0.570], p = 0.0000
- fresh-only replication (self-copied windows removed): Δ -0.292 [-0.734, +0.163], p = 0.2170, TOST ±0.75 p = 0.0285
- replication pulseG20 − habit (one-sided > 0): Δ +0.933 [+0.492, +1.358], p = 0.0002
- inter − habit (one-sided > 0): Δ +1.221 [+0.800, +1.653], p = 0.0000

## Matched-layout re-judging (round 3, N2): pulseG20 and habit judged at +32/+160 after each burst end
